# Test: Update EVE from monolithic to split-rootfs OCI image
# Scenario: monolith -> split (forward upgrade with CAS self-heal)
#
# The split OCI image contains two layers in a single ContentTree:
#   disk-root (Core squashfs) + disk-additional (Extension erofs)
#
# After OTA, the stock WriteToPartition writes disk-root to the target
# partition. The Extension (disk-additional) remains in CAS.
# After reboot, extsloader detects /etc/ext-verity-roothash in Core,
# extracts the Extension from CAS via Puller.Pull, mounts it with
# dm-verity, and starts Extension services (debug, vector, wwan, etc).
#
# Env vars:
#   EVE_VERSION  - split-rootfs EVE version tag (required)
#   EVE_REGISTRY - OCI registry path (default: lfedge/eve)

# Default EVE version to update to (split-rootfs build)
{{$eve_ver := "0.0.0"}}

# Default EVE registry
{{$eve_registry := "lfedge/eve"}}

# Obtain EVE version from environment variable EVE_VERSION
{{$env := EdenGetEnv "EVE_VERSION"}}
{{if $env}}{{$eve_ver = $env}}{{end}}

# Obtain EVE_REGISTRY from environment (e.g. "myuser/eve")
{{$env_reg := EdenGetEnv "EVE_REGISTRY"}}
{{if $env_reg}}{{$eve_registry = $env_reg}}{{end}}

{{$eve_hv := "kvm"}}
{{$env_hv := EdenGetEnv "EVE_HV"}}
{{if $env_hv}}{{$eve_hv = $env_hv}}{{end}}
{{$eve_arch := EdenConfig "eve.arch"}}
{{$short_version := printf "%s-%s-%s" $eve_ver $eve_hv $eve_arch}}
{{$test_info := "test eden.lim.test -test.v -timewait 30m -test.run TestInfo"}}
{{$devmodel := EdenConfig "eve.devmodel"}}

# ── Step 1: Verify monolithic base ──────────────────────────
# Monolithic image should NOT have ext-verity-roothash
message 'Monolith->Split: verifying monolithic base...'
eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo split || echo monolithic'
stdout 'monolithic'

# ── Step 2: Send OTA update to split image ──────────────────
# Decrease update testing time
eden controller edge-node update --config timer.test.baseimage.update=300

message 'Monolith->Split: sending update request'
eden -t 10m controller edge-node eveimage-update oci://docker.io/{{$eve_registry}}:{{$eve_ver}}-{{$eve_hv}}-{{$eve_arch}} -m adam://
! stderr .

# ── Step 3: Wait for activation on new partition ────────────
message 'Monolith->Split: waiting for update to activate...'
{{$test_info}} -out InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion 'InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].PartitionState:active InfoContent.dinfo.SwList[0].ShortVersion:{{ $short_version }}'
stdout '{{ $short_version }}'

# ── Step 4: Wait for Extension services (SSH from debug container) ──
# After reboot, extsloader extracts Extension from CAS, mounts it via
# dm-verity, and starts services. The debug container (SSH) is in the
# Extension. Retry SSH until it becomes available.
message 'Monolith->Split: waiting for Extension services (SSH)...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-ssh.sh

# ── Step 5: Verify split-rootfs state ───────────────────────
# Wait for extsloader to reach "ready" (CAS extraction + mount may still
# be in progress even after SSH is available). Then verify all state.
message 'Monolith->Split: waiting for extsloader ready state...'
exec -t 5m bash wait-extsloader.sh

message 'Monolith->Split: verifying Extension loaded via CAS self-heal...'

# dm-verity root hash must be embedded in Core
eden eve ssh 'test -f /hostfs/etc/ext-verity-roothash && echo present || echo missing'
stdout 'present'

# Extension image must exist on persist (paired with active slot)
eden eve ssh 'ls /persist/ext-img*.img'
stdout 'ext-img'

# Extension filesystem must be mounted
eden eve ssh 'mountpoint -q /persist/exts && echo mounted || echo not-mounted'
stdout 'mounted'

# dm-verity mapper device must exist (proves Extension mounted via verity, not legacy loop)
eden eve ssh 'ls /dev/mapper/exts-verity-* 2>/dev/null && echo verity-active || echo no-verity'
stdout 'verity-active'

# Only the active slot's Extension should exist; other slot should be cleaned up
eden eve ssh 'count=$(ls /persist/ext-img*.img 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "ext-img-count:$count"'
stdout 'ext-img-count:1'

# Extension was recovered via CAS self-heal (monolithic baseosmgr cannot pre-extract)
eden eve ssh 'logread | grep -q "Extension image recovered from CAS to .* (self-heal)" && echo self-healed || echo pre-extracted'
stdout 'self-healed'

# ── Universal image HV resolution verification ───────────────
# After OTA from monolithic KVM to uni, the full chain:
#   GRUB set_eve_flavor: CONFIG empty, PERSIST empty → rootfs "uni" → set_uni_boot
#   GRUB set_uni_boot: checks other partition → "kvm" → set_kvm_boot + eve_hv_type=kvm on cmdline
#   onboot.sh: reads eve_hv_type=kvm from cmdline → /run + /persist/status
#   Next GRUB boot: reads persist → "kvm" → never calls set_uni_boot again

# 1. No HV selection menu during OTA (serial console check)
exec bash check-no-grub-menu.sh

# 1b. "uni" must never reach runtime — check both the final value and that the
# safety fallback in onboot.sh was never triggered
eden eve ssh 'cat /hostfs/run/eve-hv-type 2>/dev/null | grep -qx uni && echo uni-leaked || echo hv-ok'
stdout 'hv-ok'
eden eve ssh 'logread | grep -q "eve-hv-type resolved to .uni." && echo uni-safety-triggered || echo clean-resolve'
stdout 'clean-resolve'

# 2. GRUB resolved HV and passed it on kernel cmdline
eden eve ssh 'cat /proc/cmdline | tr " " "\n" | grep "^eve_hv_type=" | head -1'
stdout 'eve_hv_type=kvm'

# 3. Runtime HV is KVM
eden eve ssh 'cat /hostfs/run/eve-hv-type 2>/dev/null || echo unknown'
stdout 'kvm'

# 4. onboot.sh wrote EFI var for next GRUB boot
eden eve ssh 'dd if=/sys/firmware/efi/efivars/eve-hv-type-7ad58f29-2b49-4f5a-9f0b-4e7bf7c2c311 bs=1 skip=4 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\0" || echo missing'
stdout 'kvm'

# 5. Rootfs says "uni" (proves it's the universal image)
eden eve ssh 'cat /hostfs/etc/eve-hv-type 2>/dev/null || echo unknown'
stdout 'uni'

# 6. Kube services filtered out (device runs as KVM)
eden eve ssh 'logread | grep -q "Skipping service kube: requires HV" && echo kube-filtered || echo kube-filter-not-found'
stdout 'kube-filtered'

message 'Monolith->Split: verified uni HV resolution (GRUB→cmdline→persist→runtime=kvm)'

# ── Step 6: Verify vault and PCR12 state ──────────────────────
# After a split-rootfs update, PCR 13 changes (new rootfs) and PCR 12
# transitions from all-zeros (monolithic) to non-zero (extsloader extends it).
# Vault must be unlocked (controller-assisted re-seal after PCR change).
message 'Monolith->Split: verifying vault unlocked after PCR change...'
eden eve ssh 'cat /run/status/vaultmgr/VaultStatus/global.json 2>/dev/null || echo no-vault-status'
eden eve ssh 'eve exec pillar cat /persist/status/vaultmgr/VaultStatus/global.json 2>/dev/null | grep -q "unlocked\|VAULT_UNLOCKED" && echo vault-unlocked || echo vault-status-check-failed'

# Verify vaultmgr waited for extsloader before unseal
eden eve ssh 'logread | grep -q "(PCR12 final); proceeding with vault setup" && echo vault-waited-for-extsloader || echo vault-wait-not-found'
stdout 'vault-waited-for-extsloader'

# Verify vault key was re-sealed with new PCR values (controller-assisted recovery)
eden eve ssh 'logread | grep -q "Re-sealing disk key" && echo vault-resealed || echo no-reseal-log'
stdout 'vault-resealed'

# Verify PCR12 was extended by extsloader (non-zero after Extension mount)
eden eve ssh 'logread | grep "PCR12 extended" | tail -1'
stdout 'PCR12 extended'

# Verify attestation waited for extsloader before first quote
eden eve ssh 'logread | grep -q "(PCR12 final); starting attestation" && echo attest-waited || echo attest-wait-not-found'
stdout 'attest-waited'

# Verify device is attested (controller accepted the quote)
eden eve ssh 'logread | grep -c "Attest Successful" | xargs -I{} test {} -gt 0 && echo attested || echo not-attested'
stdout 'attested'

message 'Monolith->Split: SUCCESS - vault unlocked, PCR12 extended, attestation passed'

message 'Monolith->Split: SUCCESS - CAS self-heal worked, Extension mounted via dm-verity'

# Test's config file
-- eden-config.yml --
test:
    controller: adam://{{EdenConfig "adam.ip"}}:{{EdenConfig "adam.port"}}
    eve:
      {{EdenConfig "eve.name"}}:
        onboard-cert: {{EdenConfigPath "eve.cert"}}
        serial: "{{EdenConfig "eve.serial"}}"
        model: {{EdenConfig "eve.devmodel"}}

-- wait-ssh.sh --
EDEN={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.bin-dist"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.eden-bin"}}
i=0
while [ $i -lt 30 ]; do
    if timeout 10 $EDEN eve ssh echo ssh-ready 2>/dev/null; then
        exit 0
    fi
    sleep 5
    i=$((i + 1))
done
echo "SSH not available after 150s"
exit 1

-- wait-extsloader.sh --
EDEN={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.bin-dist"}}/{{EdenConfig "eden.eden-bin"}}
# Wait for Extension to be mounted (the real proof extsloader succeeded).
# Check the mount point directly rather than reading state files.
i=0
while [ $i -lt 24 ]; do
    MOUNTED=$($EDEN eve ssh 'mountpoint -q /persist/exts && echo yes || echo no' 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$MOUNTED" = "yes" ]; then
        echo "Extension mounted at /persist/exts"
        exit 0
    fi
    echo "Waiting for Extension mount (attempt $((i+1))/24)..."
    sleep 10
    i=$((i + 1))
done
echo "Extension not mounted after 240s"
exit 1

-- check-no-grub-menu.sh --
#!/bin/bash
# Verify that NO boot in the current QEMU session showed the HV selection menu.
# The serial log uses logappend=on, so it may contain entries from previous runs.
# We only check from the LAST "swtpm is starting" line (marks current session).
EVE_LOG={{EdenConfig "eden.root"}}/default-eve.log

if [ ! -f "$EVE_LOG" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: EVE serial log not found at $EVE_LOG"
    exit 1
fi

# Extract current session: everything after the last "swtpm is starting"
CURRENT=$(tac "$EVE_LOG" | sed '/swtpm is starting/q' | tac)

if echo "$CURRENT" | grep -q "Boot/Install EVE"; then
    echo "FAIL: GRUB HV selection menu appeared during a boot!"
    echo "--- GRUB menu lines in current session ---"
    echo "$CURRENT" | grep -E "Boot/Install|Boot 0\." | head -10
    exit 1
fi

echo "OK: No GRUB HV selection menu on any boot in current session"
